summary: Swiftcurrent Ridge lookout in Glacier County: a 1930s frame cabin, then a 60-foot steel tower moved to Red Eagle in 1959 (or 1960) and gone by 1986.

facts.status_note: The 1930s frame cabin is gone; the 60-foot steel tower was moved to Red Eagle and was gone there by 1986. No source read describes either site today.

events.note: 60-foot steel tower moved from Swiftcurrent Ridge to Red Eagle, two miles SSW of Saint Mary (firelookout.com)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1959 for the move to Red Eagle on both its pages; WillhiteWeb gives 1960. The story uses 1959 and says WillhiteWeb differs.

sources.title: Many Glacier (Swiftcurrent Ridge) Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Move year conflicts (1959 on firelookout.com, 1960 on WillhiteWeb). The 1930s cabin has no exact year, so no event was written for it. Red Eagle has its own FFLA entry (48.71739, -113.44785, Tower Gone) that was not researched here. A search result describes a separate Swiftcurrent Fire Lookout on Swiftcurrent Mountain as a standing structure; it was not checked or used, and should not be confused with this site. Access is not described by any source read, so the record's access stays unknown.
